title: rhus aromatica var. suaveolens
intro: Rhus aromatica var. suaveolens, commonly known as Fragrant Sumac, is a shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant is valued for its aromatic leaves and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Fragrant Sumac include anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties, making it effective in soothing skin irritations and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
